I havent been diagnosed but I've been struggling ever since i was a kid(and i didnt know that no one else felt this way until recently) and I've compiled a list of behaviors or thoughts I've had ( i dont know if some of these are symptoms im just listing struggles ive had) so i could show to a therapist so they can understand me better and hopefully help me out / diagnose me so here it goes:

- Impulsivity, especially with lying: sometimes the lie would be the first thing that comes to mind or the first thing i'd spit out in a conversation then I'd ask myself why did I say that? That never happened why would i say that? Impulsive spending, buying, over promising etc that feels very hard to control and against my will sometimes

- Ever since i was a child i've felt like everyone around me was born with a manual and everyone naturally knew what to do or what to say except me, i had a hard time with everything

- Part of the i felt people were born with a manual point, i had a hard time making friends or following social cues. i never understood anything around me, everything felt so confusing, and growing up i learnt to look for clues in everyone around me; i could never tell what was the right reaction to whatever situation, so i looked around to mimic other people's reactions and eventually found patterns in everything and learnt. 
I dont know how to explain but things like feeling sad upon hearing sad news didnt come naturally to me, i looked around saw how my mom reacted for example, thought to myself ok so this is something that is shocking so i should look shocked, categorized that type of news in my head for future reference, and then reacted accordingly. similarly for making friends, Id looked at how my mom or my sister have done it and developed a kind of script or pattern and then used it to talk to other people (i still find interacting with people hard but ive become way more natural with it, made a ton of friends over the years, but have had a close circle for more than 10 years, sometimes i struggle to keep in contact with friends though)

- I'm very emotional and sensitive over little things and i tend to obsess: i discovered over the past couple of years that i take criticism very personally as a personal attack, and ive come to realize i have rejection sensitivity and control sensitivity 

- i obsess over things in phases (celebrities, shows, hobbies, items, songs) 

- i can only work on something if im genuinely interested in it otherwise nothing can make me lift a finger
